en:
As I suspected, it's full of stuff
related to magic tricks—

Whose research lab is this? If it's supposed to
be mine, then there should be magical items...
Right?
Right...? Why are you asking me?

Nyeeeh...they mixed up magic tricks and real
magic. But this is a pretty thorough collection.

It seems like there are labs for everyone.
But why prepare so many?
What *is* this place...?

Monokuma said that this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Academy for 
Gifted Juveniles<CLT=cltNORMAL> was made for the 16 of us...
Is that really true?

Hey... The rooms in the dorms have 
locks, but this research lab doesn't...
Ah, it looks like they're not private.

Are you okay with that, Himiko?
Your magic tricks might get stolen.

You need skills to perform magic tricks. 
Knowing how they work isn't enough...
But I use real magic, not magic tricks.

<CLT=cltMIND>She's not going to budge
an inch on that point...

You need skills to perform magic tricks. 
Knowing how they work isn't enough...
But I use real magic, not magic tricks.

<CLT=cltMIND>She's not going to budge
an inch on that point...

To think there was a room like this
beyond that wall...

I wonder why they went out of their way 
to hide it, though.

Miu and Kaede's research labs were 
open from the start.
That's right...

Oh, sorry... It's probably better to...
not bring up Kaede just yet, huh?

Ah, no, it's fine.
I'm...okay.

I see... Well, that's a relief.
I was just plain worried.

I don't know how just yet, 
but like Kaede said...

Let's survive...and escape this place, 
no matter what.
I don't know how just yet, but...

Let's survive...and escape this place,
just like Kaede told us to.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.
What is this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a huge cauldron, like one a witch
would be stirring in a children's book...

Don't go touching whatever you want...
That pot is collecting mana...
Mana...?

Don't you know? It's a necessary energy 
source for magic.
Oh, I see. You mean, like ether or life force?

Hm, the names are different depending on 
the school of magic, but I call it mana.

This place is filled with mana.
It's perfect for me.
Is that so...?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a huge cauldron on the fire...
What kind of magic trick is *this* for?
<CLT=cltMIND>What a huge saw...

This room can't be locked. So...we don't just
have to worry about the tricks being stolen...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi didn't finish her sentence,
but I knew what she wanted to say.

It's not that I'm thinking the...killings are 
going to happen again, but...
...Right.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can really feel it now...
Just how bizarre this situation is...
<CLT=cltMIND>What a huge saw...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's probably used for the
saw-a-person-in-half trick.
What is this...?

That's the magic trick where the person in the
box is stabbed by swords, but comes out fine.

It's not a trick...
That's one of the Space-type spells.
Space-type?
Ooh, that sounds like high-ranking magic!
Exactly...

You need a lot of skill for Space-type spells... 
No average mage can handle them.
Mhm, mhm. So in other words...

You couldn't just be a mage, you'd have to be a 
sage... You'd need the Words of Wisdom for that.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi was somehow able
to follow all of that...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are several swords stabbed into
a human-sized box.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if there was a person inside, they
would come out just fine. That's the trick, I think.

<CLT=cltMIND>...This is going to be used for magic too.
I've seen it in a magic show...
This is a big cage...

Hey, Himiko. What kind of magic trick 
do you use the cage for?

It's not a trick... 
I'm telling you, it's real magic...
Oh, sorry! I forgot about that.

I use that for a number of spells...
It's also good for carrying my familiar.
Familiar...?

Oh, you mean that trick where a dove 
comes out of your hat?
Er...you mean a magical animal?

Yes, that's right... But my familiar isn't 
a dove, it's a tiger cub.
A tiger cub!

It must be so cute! I'm jealous of you, being 
able to pet something fluffy like that whenever.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll admit, even I'm kind of jealous...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a big cage...
I might fit inside this...
<CLT=cltMIND>This is...a guillotine, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I know it's just for a magic trick,
but it still kind of creeps me out...

<CLT=cltMIND>...It's a huge water tank.
I wonder if this is for a magic trick too.
